name: refund-eligibility
description: Is the item the customer asks to return eligible under the policy? Pick the item from the message, apply its category window counted inclusively, the unopened-unless-defective rule for electronics, and final-sale / gift-card exclusions.

input.policy_text:
Returns policy.
1. Most items can be returned within 30 days of delivery.
2. Electronics can be returned within 15 days of delivery, and only if unopened, unless the item is defective (then within 30 days).
3. Items marked final sale and gift cards cannot be returned.
The delivery day counts as day 1 of the window, so a request made on day 30 is within a 30-day window and one made on day 31 is not.
